option_relations.rationale: The presence of a left-sided lacrimal sac abscess with postseptal fat stranding and the description of the condition as an orbital abscess secondary to acute dacryocystitis matches the leaf label 'Orbital Abscess'.
Acute dacryocystitis with orbital cellulitis can be considered a subtype of orbital inflammation due to other causes, as it involves inflammation of the orbit secondary to dacryocystitis.
Orbital cellulitis secondary to dacryocystitis is a specific cause of orbital inflammation, which aligns with the leaf label 'Orbital Inflammation due to Other Causes'.
While acute dacryocystitis with secondary optic nerve injury is a possible diagnosis, there is no direct relation to the provided leaf labels.
